body:
My dear friend,

Some of our neighbours live far out across the snowy fields, and the drifts are deep. I've packed baskets of food for them.

I've drawn a map of the way. Would you help me carry them?
summary: Follow Mrs. Hannah's map to deliver winter baskets.
done: Every basket found its way home!

tasks.where: at Mrs. Hannah's farm (take the map)
in the grove behind the chapel
